name: As Foretold
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a time counter on this enchantment.
Once each turn, you may pay {0} rather than pay the mana cost for a spell you cast with mana value X or less, where X is the number of time counters on this enchantment.
blocked_sentences: Once each turn, you may pay {0} rather than pay the mana cost for a spell you cast with mana value X or less, where X is the number of time counters on this enchantment.

needs.what: a player-wide alternative-cost static (pay {0} instead of the mana cost) that (a) may be used only once each turn per granting permanent, counted when a spell is cast under it, and (b) filters spells by mana value <= a dynamic value read from the source, here counters_on {counter: time, objects: {self_only: true}}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: free_cast_permission and granted_alternative_cost both replace the mana cost for an affects_spells class, but neither honours static_max_per_turn (only cast_from_graveyard does) so either would be unbounded rather than once each turn, and their filters are SPELL_FILTER_KEYS / FREE_CAST_FILTER_KEYS matched against the printed face only, with no mana_value comparison against a static value such as counters_on the source; spell_cost_reduction only reduces the generic part and is not an alternative cost
